text:
Samir Patel: Linking the PM follow-up for the KV-cache postmortem — we need to assign owners for the three remediation items and open Jira tickets. Who can own 'cache eviction gated backoff' and 'alert for cache-throttle'?
Jenna Cho: I'll take cache eviction backoff. I'll create a JIRA and tag infra. ETA EOW. :thumbsup:
Pax Williams: I'll do alerting + runbook updates. Can we follow RACI: Pax (R), Samir (A), Jenna (C), Lina (I)?
Lina Gomez: Sounds good. I'm fine as I for now. Can we add Ops rotation handoff? @Tay Ops, can you add to oncall docs?
Tay Ops: yes, will add to /runbooks/oncall-cache-eviction.md and link it in the Jira. Also I'll do a short playbook snippet for the pager flow.
Samir Patel: Please include the troubleshooting commands we used in the outage: ```kubectl logs -n infra -l app=redwood-runtime | grep kv``` and `rundump --since 2h`. Put those in the Jira description and the runbook.
Jenna Cho: Jira created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REMEDY-2412 title "cache eviction backoff + QoS". Assigning to Jenna. Due 2025-06-13.
Pax Williams: Jira for alerting is REMEDY-2413. I set priority P2 and added alert runbook. @IncidentBot can you watch REMEDY-2413 for regressions?
IncidentBot: I will send regression reminders weekly for REMEDY-2413 and ping #eng-oncall if thresholds retrigger.
Lina Gomez: Recurring incident note: spike every ~3 weeks correlated with sequence-length bump after the nightly batch job. Suggest scheduled kv-warmup pre-batch. Putting that as action REMEDY-2414.
Samir Patel: Good catch. Can we triage whether recent quantization changes or kernel selection shifts contributed? @Pax and @Jenna please log any config deltas in the tickets. Timeline: owners set, tickets open, canary patch targeted for the deployment window 2025-06-20. If owners cannot meet, escalate to me.
Tay Ops: I'll prototype a kv-warmup script and attach it to REMEDY-2414 by Tue. Will also add smoke checks. :eyes:
Jenna Cho: I'll add an explicit RACI table to REMEDY-2412 description and link REMEDY-2413/2414. Closing loop: owners = Jenna (backoff), Pax (alerting), Tay (warmup/runbook), Samir accountable. Anyone object?
Pax Williams: ack
Lina Gomez: ack
Samir Patel: Thanks team. I'll update the postmortem doc with ticket links and mark action owners and deadlines. Will follow up in next remediation sync.
